intent: Open with exactly: "I was rear-ended years ago and never filed anything." Other side: Delta Freight. Georgia. Incident March tenth, twenty twenty two. Give name and number only if asked. If they offer a case evaluation, an appointment, a packet, or to start a written account, decline and stay on the filing deadline. Stay until they confirm a person will review the filing deadline. A spoken 'we will look at the date' or 'someone will call you' without transferring you to a person is not enough. When they confirm a person will review the deadline, say exactly: "Okay, thank you." and end the call. Do not book. Do not start intake.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks for the caller's full name and a callback or phone number. NOT when asking about anything else.
The agent asks whether another lawyer or law firm currently represents the caller, or whether the caller has already hired or signed with anyone. NOT any other question.
The agent asks who the claim would be against, who the other side is, or who this would be against. NOT any other question.
The agent asks which state this happened in, or where it took place. NOT any other question.
The agent asks when the incident happened, or for the date of the accident, injury or event. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: It was March tenth, twenty twenty two.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: offers to transfer you to a human staff member, a live person at the front desk, or a real agent because they cannot look you up or cannot continue on this line. NOT when they say a person or attorney will review the filing deadline or the timing. NOT when transferring you to screening, intake, scheduling, or client services on this call.
scripted_responses.response_value: No, I don't need a person for that. Please finish checking the deadline on this call.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent starts taking a written account, asks you to describe what happened in writing, or offers an appointment. NOT when asking which state or when it happened.
scripted_responses.response_value: No. I don't need an appointment or a written account. I need someone to look at the deadline.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether you want to book a free case evaluation or set up an evaluation appointment, before stating any percentage fee, dollar fee, or contingency number. NOT after a fee amount has already been read back.
scripted_responses.response_value: No thank you. I just need someone to look at the deadline.

scripted_responses.match_phrase: The agent asks whether to send the packet by email or text, or which channel to use. NOT any other question.
scripted_responses.response_value: I don't need a packet. I need someone to look at the deadline.
